name: Rizuhble's It's Alive And Armed
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Grit
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Losing trades up close. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-5,600 (levels 1-11). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Shocking Reanimation unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Swift Striker. Ultimate (Shocking Reanimation) is available from Rapid Rounds.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 6 purchases

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Lifesteal, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 3,200 souls on. Upgrade of High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Extended Magazine (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 5,600-20,800 (levels 11-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Pain Battery T3, Jumpstart T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pain Battery, damage) grows from 129 to 356. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Bullet Lifesteal, spirit 4.8k at Mercurial Magnum.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Lifesteal, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Bullet Lifesteal completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Bullet Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Bullet Lifesteal completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Bullet Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Jumpstart: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Berserker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Jumpstart: takes 18% off its 22s base cooldown.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k, 8k tiers): bonus 19 to 52 spirit power. Imbued on Jumpstart: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 20,800-33,600 (levels 26-31). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Shocking Reanimation T3.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 33,600-51,200 (levels 31-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Aura of Suffering T3.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 171s; 20% off is 34.2s per full rotation.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Frenzy
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Berserker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.
sections.desc: Dying after Berserker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun carry outshoots you up close.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: They hit you with Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex or Knockdown.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns and slows keep you off them.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 52 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 171s of base cooldown across your kit, 145s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 52 to 66 spirit power. Replaces Swift Striker: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Resets your revive too, so you can come back twice in one fight. Sell Swift Striker for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
